annotations.title: New companies in Poland (KRS and CEIDG)

description: Use for how many new companies (sp. z o.o., S.A., partnerships) are registered in KRS each month and for all new firms in Poland together with sole proprietorships. For closures and suspensions of sole proprietorships, use get_business_registrations. New commercial companies entered in the Polish National Court Register (KRS) each month by legal form (limited liability, simple joint-stock, joint-stock, partnerships), counted by finwire.pl from the Ministry of Justice KRS API (daily bulletin and current extracts), with applications to register a sole proprietorship in CEIDG (MRiT) for the same month, the share of companies among new firms, the current month so far against the same days a year earlier and the finwire index finwire_new_companies_pulse (new sole proprietorships plus new companies, % year on year).

history.description: Number of past months in the summary, default 12.
